comparison.objective: Make a sealed copper-pipe compression joint.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence pipe, olive, and nut, seat the pipe, then regrasp a spanner for controlled tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe within 1 mm of stop, olive correctly captured, nut 0.75–1.25 turns past snug, spanner returned; overtightening fails.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered assembly and torque/turn control, not controlled impact fracture and debris recovery.
